in_sanskrit.name: Kyra
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Maiden, virgin
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kyra एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Greek word 'kyrios' meaning lord, Kyra is a feminine name of Greek origin. However, in Hindu mythology, the name is also associated with goddesses like Saraswati and Durga, signifying purity, knowledge, and power.
